Readings of these rows: a different county in Oklahoma (`Dewey County, NW Oklahoma`) against the Stephens county prototype is `not_evaluable` --- a different label at the same level, neither compatible nor incompatible; a state-level or multi-state geography against a county or cell prototype is `not_evaluable` (different granularity); `California, Arizona and Nevada` against `California` is `not_evaluable` (a list of states is not the label); an `inferred` geography never reaches G-1.

**G-2 list.** Only the committed M5-WP1 list is used (China, India, Tajikistan, Australia disjoint; `global`, `worldwide`, `Northwest Atlantic` not disjoint; US markers). Places outside the United States that are not on it --- Sardinia, France, Greece, Italy, Portugal, Spain, the Sahel, the Iberian Peninsula --- give `not_evaluable`, not `incompatible`. Extending the list was not authorized here.

Relation rules, in precedence: `contradicting`: concept positive (metric or family) and geography compatible, and direction is the only incompatible dimension; `incompatible`: any dimension incompatible (and not contradicting); `supporting`: eligible; concept metric-compatible; scenario, time and direction all compatible; `supporting_qualified`: eligible; direction compatible or not_evaluable; family-level concept or scenario/time not_evaluable; `related_insufficient`: concept positive (metric or family), not eligible (geography not compatible), nothing incompatible; `uncertain`: otherwise.
